item.title: Slipknot No Longer Suing Slipknot.com
item.description: Last October, Slipknot filed a lawsuit against Slipknot.com and its owner. Now, after getting pushback from the domain registrant, the band has filed a notice of voluntary dismissal. The post Slipknot No Longer Suing Slipknot.com appeared first on Stereogum.

item.title: Pharrell Williams Sued By Former Neptunes Partner Chad Hugo
item.description: In 2024, Chad Hugo filed a legal action against his former Neptunes partner Pharrell Williams, accusing him of attempting to register trademarks for the Neptunes name without consulting Hugo. Now, Hugo is suing Pharrell, claiming he cut him out of their company and owes him up to $1 million from an N.E.R.D. album. The post Pharrell Williams Sued By Former Neptunes Partner Chad Hugo appeared first on Stereogum.

item.title: Watch Denzel Curry Join Fred again.. In New York
item.description: Last year, Denzel Curry hopped on a remix of Fred again..'s "Victory Lap," which featured Skepta and PlaqueBoyMax. Last night at New York's East End Studios, the DJ brought out the Miami rapper to perform his 2015 hit "Ultimate." It was the third show out of six for Fred again..'s USB002 campaign; previously he was joined by Romy to cover her music and the xx. Yesterday he released the Young Thug collaboration "scared." item.title: Yungblud Apologizes For Photo With Rammstein Frontman
item.description: Earlier this month, Yungblud went viral for speaking up for Iranian women's rights. The English rock musician is known for advocacy, and fans were recently disappointed to see a photo of him posing with Rammstein frontman Till Lindemann, who has sexual misconduct allegations. Today, he acknowledged the backlash, saying he "had no idea" about the accusations. The post Yungblud Apologizes For Photo With Rammstein Frontman appeared first on Stereogum.

item.title: Watch Geese Make Their SNL Debut
item.description: It happened: Geese performed on SNL for the first time last night, a month after frontman Cameron Winter was parodied on the show. The Brooklyn rock band — which along with Winter includes drummer Max Bassin, guitarist Emily Green, bassist Dominic DiGesu, and touring keyboardist Sam Revaz — played "Au Pays Du Cocaine" and "Trinidad" from their album Getting Killed, the Best Album Of 2025. The post Watch Geese Make Their <em>SNL</em> Debut appeared first on Stereogum.
